recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add CarePlan or CommunicationRequest insurance core elements based on FHIR-14064; any future CommunicationRequest insurance requirement should be handled as a new work-group or extension-scope tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-14064 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for STU3 requesting Request pattern synchronization for CarePlan and CommunicationRequest. The Jira resolution points to the resolved spreadsheet's yellow-approved changes and says orange items would be discussed later.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 2b7da674b79341d6d80ecb41a72875a885b3fbcb, which updated the then-authoritative CarePlan and CommunicationRequest spreadsheets/examples for the approved GF#14064 workflow alignment changes.
additional_context: CarePlan and CommunicationRequest are active approved resources in source/fhir.ini. Later final decisions intentionally changed the FHIR-14064 surfaces: FHIR-28544 renamed CarePlan.author to custodian, FHIR-39101 removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail, FHIR-40500 removed CarePlan instantiates[x], and FHIR-26951 separately clarified CommunicationRequest.informationProvider. reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core source already reflects the approved FHIR-14064 scope as subsequently renamed, removed, or superseded by later work-group decisions.
